newsitem.title: USA: Excite to offer Web search customisation.
newsitem.headline: Excite to offer Web search customisation.

text.p: Excite Inc. said it will on Monday roll out custom search features that make it easier for users to take advantage of the company's technology for finding information on the Web.
The new capabilities include an "Excite Power search form" which enables users to expand or limit the reach of a search through simple pull-down menus.
A new Excite Search Wizard uses an automated software capability which helps guide users through the search process without their having to know specific query language.

According to a survey of unduplicated audience reach last week by PC Meter, which records residential Internet use, Excite reached 47.6 percent levels in March, according to a study released by Excite last week.
Excite combines four Internet brands -- Excite, WebCrawler, Excite City.Net and Magellan.
The company said the PC Meter figures were the largest in the navigation category since PC Meter began measuring usage in January 1996.
Excite competes with Yahoo Inc., Infoseek and Lycos and other so-called search engines in helping people find information on the Web. (sam.perry@reuters.com, Palo Alto Bureau 415 846 5400))
